reviews.text: My experience at this engineering college has been good. The faculty members are supportive and helpful. The college provides a good learning environment, proper facilities, and opportunities to improve technical skills. Overall, I am satisfied with the teaching and educational environment of the college.

I am very happy with my experience at this college . Because in my college teachers are very supportive and knowlegable.
They don't only teach us they also support us in doing our best

Good college , good environment and all lab available
Industrial visits are organized here for second-year students.

I am a 2022 Mechanical Engineering from Banaras Institute of Polytechnic & Engineering, Varanasi. My experience at this college was very positive. The faculty members were supportive, knowledgeable, and always encouraged us to improve both our technical knowledge and practical skills.
Number 1 college in varanasi

Hello Friends 👋Today, with the knowledge and skills I gained during my time at the college, I am working as an Engineer in the manufacturing industry with a good salary package. I am grateful to the faculty and the institution for helping me build a successful career.

I would recommend Banaras Institute of Polytechnic & Engineering to students who want quality technical education and a strong start to their professional journey.
